name: Canvas
summary: Stretched artist's canvas leaning upright on the floor, blank, landscape or abstract painting; for art scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the canvas's bottom edge rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size: at s = 1 the canvas is about 460 px wide and 580 px tall

params.name: art
params.note: blank = unpainted white canvas; landscape = simple hills and sun; abstract = colour blocks

params.name: anim
params.note: wobble = the canvas rocks very slightly

author: krakujs
